task.title: P6-099: Fix dark theme background too dark, blending into card borders
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 7 — UX, a11y and visual, Visual and layout). Original id: P6-099. Size: S. Specs: specs/ui-design.md, specs/app-ui.md.

**Black background is too dark and card borders blend into it.** `style/input.css`'s `.dark` background sits at L=0.18 against a border of white at 10 % alpha. The token pairing is a code fact; "too dark" is a design judgment, so route it through a deliberate dark-theme contrast pass rather than nudging one value.
